pages.observation: The image hash in this request matches the earlier page 09 requests, and the image looks the same as my earlier reading. The order is clear: a two-by-two grid read left to right and top to bottom, then the full-width bottom tier. 'On the day' carries the time skip after the reminder. 'As usual' depends on the reader remembering page 04's slot screen. Ravi does not answer 'Welcome back, Ravi. Your results are already here.' The page ends on a caption, so his reaction has to come from the art. Meera's role in Panel C is unexplained; she is a tiny placeholder with no action, which sits oddly with 'No queue at the desk'. The tail in Panel E points correctly to Ananya. No text overflows its box, and everything is readable. The captions in Panels A to D sit close to the top borders but do not cross them.
